points.point: 每條規格主張必須標明型號與來源文件版次，來源未標版次就要明說沒標
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions exact models and cites spec filenames with versions, but does not state the rule that every spec claim must carry model plus document version or explicitly say version not marked

points.point: 規格數字必須連同測試條件一起引用，不換算單位；option 相依性照抄原文，不自行推論相容性
points.label: partial
points.why: says options/configurations must be cited from specifications, but omits citing test conditions, not converting units, and not inferring option compatibility

points.point: 只有 specifications with limits / without limits 代表保證效能；typ./nom./meas./n. trc. 不由 R&S 保證，不能用來做比較主張
points.label: missing
points.why: does not distinguish specifications with/without limits from typ./nom./meas./n. trc. or say typical values cannot be used for comparisons

points.point: 訊號分析儀規格文件同樣註明無 tolerance limits 的資料不具約束力且可能變更
points.label: missing
points.why: does not state analyzer data without tolerance limits is non-binding and subject to change

points.point: 對競品的主張若只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源，用於客戶文件前必須另查對手官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: covered
points.why: states internal battle-card-only competitor claims need official competitor data and third-party evidence before customer use

points.point: only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO 等銷售語言不可當作可驗證技術規格
points.label: partial
points.why: says sales battle cards are not binding technical specifications, but does not specifically reject only platform/first validated/leadership/lower TCO style claims

points.point: 現有 battle card 未提供競品的正式 datasheet、文件版次、order number、option code、release status 或測試條件
points.label: partial
points.why: notes missing official competitor documents or third-party data, but not the full set of absent datasheet version/order number/option code/release status/test conditions

points.point: Aerospace / Defense（衛星、UAV）的 R&S solution mapping 只是 sales mapping，不可當作測試配置建議書，仍需 sales kits、application notes、datasheet 或正式 proposal
points.label: partial
points.why: says current sources do not directly support an A&D competitor comparison and more A&D evidence is needed, but omits the satellite/UAV sales-mapping limitation and required sales kits/application notes/datasheets/formal proposal
